comparison.objective: Read a setup sheet, set multiple controls and execute a two-hand machine start; candidate adjusts a damper and runs guarded validation cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Dial, slider, switch and simultaneous-button manipulation versus hex-key insertion, collar rotation, counterholding and iterative physical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Exact P2 settings and valid two-hand start with no forbidden inputs versus isolated adjustment followed by two safe, repeatable impact cycles and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both test machine setup and physical control actuation, but the existing task tests symbolic control configuration, not mechanical force-response commissioning. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, drift and tightening thresholds.
